text_block_list.text:
I want to build up the slender Tamamo Cross's body.
However, she won't eat at an ordinary all-you-can-eat buffet.
In that case—

We've got no choice but to prepare something even more delicious.
By getting help from the two strongest
people at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it~. So I just have to make
the most wonderfully buono dish for Tamamo-san, right~☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me~. I'll make something with a gentle flavor so good it'll melt on your tongue~♪
Super Creek, unmatched in the academy when it comes to making home-cooked 'mother's flavors', and Hishi Akebono, renowned as the academy's top chef.
I decided to conquer it all in one go with the two-front approach of Mom appeal and Bono appeal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Tama-chan. Here's your food for today.
Open wide and say 'ahh'~, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's suuuper buono~☆
Dosukoi! Dosukoi!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Grmmm... It sure looks tasty.
Looks tasty, but~..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What kind of comedy routine is this?!
Cheering for sumo wrestlers with my mom while eating,
that makes no sense, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, ya know...
No matter how good the food ya make for me is, I can't eat it.
It ain't about that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's like tryin' to pour a whole bucket of water
into a tiny cup all at once. That's just impossible...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, even if it's delicious, it's not good enough? That's so tricky...

The strategy failed... Things didn't go smoothly.
It seems we need to think of our next move.

If it couldn't be resolved through taste alone...
I decided to tackle it from a different angle.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Tamamo-senpai, mind if I sit next to you?
There aren't any other open seats.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's up, City? You having lunch too?
Works for me.

This Umamusume is Gold City.
She's in the same generation as Tamamo Cross.

While working as a model,
she also competes in the Twinkle Series.
When I explained the situation, she readily agreed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that amount... You eat a ton, don'tcha?
Can ya really maintain a model's body like that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. If I don't eat at least this much,
I won't be able to maintain my weight, in fact."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I do watch what I eat...
but I still have to make sure I get the nutrients I need.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's racing or modeling, I won't see it through
unless I eat properly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: See it through? Eat to see it through?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Eating is part of the job. That's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My body knows it too.
That's why I think it craves it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you're not healthy, you can't express
anything... Gotta eat well today too,
and do a good job.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Only if you're healthy... huh?
Yeah... you're right...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I don't really want to win from the bottom of my heart yet...
If that's the case...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Phew... Is this good?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, I just spoke what's always
on my mind. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-senpai has always treated me so well.
Someday, in a race...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm gonna eat properly.
Even if it's little by little, I'll eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Thinking 'I can't eat, so I won't eat'... Slipping into that mindset just means I haven't steeled my resolve yet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There are things I can't do unless I eat.
There are things I've gotta get done.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If I don't eat proper as much as I can, I won't stand a chance against City and the others!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's keep 'em coming!!

After talking with Gold City,
Tamamo Cross seemed to reconsider, realizing
that eating is, at the very least, important.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Tama-chan♪
Yesss, there are plenty of seconds too, you know~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We also have super buono, mountain-high chanko nabe~.
Make sure you eat it a~ll up, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaaaah!? No matter how you look at it, who could eat a mountain like this?!

Even with tears welling in her eyes...
Tamamo Cross desperately kept moving her chopsticks to her mouth.
